concerns.text: Three stale duplicate contracts remain in the repo: drift_result.schema.yaml, log.schema.yaml, taxonomy.schema.yaml. The plan's 'Unresolved Concerns Resolution' item 6 claims these were 'consolidated into four schemas', and the Project Structure tree lists only the four canonical schemas — but the files still exist. log.schema.yaml even references 'ATBench', a dataset absent from the spec. These are plan elements with no backing FR/SC (over-reach / leftover from a rejected draft); delete them or the implementer will build against contradictory contracts.
